password.title: Sign in with contract
password.description: Enter your Ufanet contract number and personal-cabinet password.

phone.title: Sign in by phone call
phone.description: For accounts without a password (connected via a management company). Enter the phone number tied to the account.

phone_confirm.title: Call to confirm
phone_confirm.description: From the phone tied to the account, call **{phone_to_call}** (free — hang up after the ring). Then press Confirm.

reauth_password.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_password.description: Session expired for contract **{contract}**. Enter the personal-cabinet password again.

setup.title: Addresses and SIP
setup.description: Tick the doors from this account. Clear an address here, or delete its device on the integration page: it will not come back. SIP can be filled in now. The checkbox opens this window the next time you press Configure.

data.show_setup_again: Show this window the next time settings are opened

reauth_phone.title: Reauthenticate by phone
reauth_phone.description: Session expired. Sign in again with a confirmation call.

abort.phone_apply_failed: Could not obtain tokens after the call. Try again.
abort.no_intercoms: No intercoms available for this account.
abort.wrong_account: The confirmed call belongs to a different contract.

error.no_intercoms: No intercoms available for this account.
error.phone_init_failed: Could not start phone sign-in. Check the number and retry.
error.phone_call_not_detected: Call not detected yet. Dial the number and continue.

gate.title: Settings
gate.description: The address and SIP window is closed. Tick the box to open it.

data.show_setup_again: Show the address and SIP window

setup.title: Addresses and SIP
setup.description: Tick the doors from this account. Clear an address here, or delete its device on the integration page: it will not come back. An empty SIP login leaves the monitor off. The checkbox opens this window again from Configure.

data.show_setup_again: Show this window the next time settings are opened

abort.auth: Session expired. Reauthenticate the integration first.
abort.no_intercoms: No intercoms available for this account.
